## Highlights

- Added new `--begin`/`-b` option to start/pause progress of tasks. (#105) 904a007
- Restore functionality of `--copy` option on snap package. (#123) d917db2
- Improved functionality of `--find` option. (#126) (#110) (#111) 97eb4ec aaf244f
- Prevent usage of `--begin` & `--check` options on note items. 39a0d4a
- Render `note` instead of `notes` on single note item existence. (#106) 57b3990
- Docs: Sorted flag options & examples alphabetically. (#107) 1d044f8
- Renamed `in progress` indicator to `in-progress` on stats overview. 080f4c3
- Docs: Added French Translation. (#121) afe62af
- Docs: Improvements for the French Translation. (#122) b0dda8b
- Updated snapcraft package versioning to `x.y.z` format. 0f35d99
- Renamed `lib` directory to `src`. 82c8742
- Docs: Fixed minor typo. (#120) 1c60acd
- Upgraded snapcraft node-engine@10.15.0. fe2ec38

## Thanks

Huge thank you to @codehearts, @allen-munsch, @samsawan, @jalandis, @johnlunney & @Maltemo for contributing and helping out with this release!

## All changes

[klaussinani/taskbook@`v0.2.0...v0.3.0`](https://github.com/klaussinani/taskbook/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0)
